title.zh: 卷一百四十四 列傳第三十一: 答里麻 月魯帖木兒 卜顏鐵木兒 星吉 福壽 道童
title.en: Volume 144 Biographies 31: Dalima, Yuelutiemuer, Buyantiemuer, Xingji, Fushou, Daotong
title.raw: 卷一百四十四 列傳第三十一: 答里麻 月魯帖木兒 卜顏鐵木兒 星吉 福壽 道童 Volume 144 Biographies 31: Dalima, Yuelutiemuer, Buyantiemuer, Xingji, Fushou, Daotong

sentences.zh: 答里麻

translations.literal: Dalima
translations.idiomatic: Dalima

sentences.zh: 答里麻，高昌人。

translations.literal: Dalima was a man of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima was from Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 大父撒吉斯，为辽王傅，世祖称其贤。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Sagisi served as tutor to the Prince of Liao; the Shizu Emperor praised his worth.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Sagisi had been tutor to the Prince of Liao, and Emperor Shizu had praised his virtue.

sentences.zh: 从讨李璮，以勋授山东行省大都督。

translations.literal: He followed in the campaign against Li Tan and, for meritorious service, was appointed Dadudu of the Shandong Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against Li Tan and, for his achievements, was appointed Dadudu of the Shandong Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 答里麻弱冠入宿卫。

translations.literal: Dalima entered palace guard service in his early twenties.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima joined the imperial guard in his early twenties.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，授御药院达鲁花赤，迁回回药物院，寻出佥湖北、山南两道廉访司事，召拜监察御史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade he was appointed Darughachi of the Imperial Pharmacy, transferred to the Muslim Medicaments Office, then sent out as associate of the surveillance commissions of the Hubei and Shannan circuits, and summoned to be appointed Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1307 he was made Darughachi of the Imperial Pharmacy, then moved to the Muslim Medicaments Office; shortly afterward he was sent out as an associate of the surveillance commissions for Hubei and Shannan, and was summoned to serve as a supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 时丞相帖木迭兒专权贪肆，答里麻帅同寅亦怜真、马祖常劾其罪。

translations.literal: At that time the Chancellor Temuder monopolized power and was greedy and ruthless; Dalima led his colleagues Yirenzhen and Ma Zuchang in impeaching his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chancellor Temuder held sole power and was rapacious; Dalima led his colleagues Yirenzhen and Ma Zuchang in impeaching him.

sentences.zh: 高昌僧恃丞相威，违法娶妇南城，答里麻诘问之，奋不顾利害，风纪由是大振。

translations.literal: A Gaochang monk, relying on the chancellor's might, unlawfully took a wife in the southern capital; Dalima interrogated him, heedless of profit or harm, and discipline was thereby greatly strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: A monk from Gaochang, relying on the chancellor's power, illegally took a wife in the southern capital; Dalima questioned him, caring nothing for personal risk, and official discipline was greatly restored.

sentences.zh: 擢河东道廉访副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Hedong Circuit Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commissioner of the Hedong surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 隰州村民赛神，因醉殴杀姚甲，为首者乘闹逃去，有司逮同会者系狱，历岁不决。

translations.literal: Villagers in Xi Prefecture held a sacrifice to the gods; while drunk one beat and killed Yao Jia; the ringleader escaped amid the commotion; the authorities arrested those present at the gathering and imprisoned them, and for a year no verdict was reached.
translations.idiomatic: In Xi Prefecture, villagers were holding a temple festival when, in a drunken brawl, one man beat and killed Yao Jia. The ringleader fled in the uproar; officials arrested everyone who had been present and kept them in prison for a year without resolving the case.

sentences.zh: 答里麻曰：「杀人者既逃，存亡不可知，此辈皆诖误无罪，而反桎梏耶？」

translations.literal: Dalima said: "The killer has fled and whether he lives or dies is unknown; these people are all wrongly implicated and without guilt—yet they are to be fettered?"
translations.idiomatic: Dalima said, "The killer has escaped and we do not even know whether he is alive or dead. These people are all innocent victims of mistaken implication—why should they be shackled?"

sentences.zh: 悉纵之。

translations.literal: He released them all.
translations.idiomatic: He released them all.

sentences.zh: 至治元年，帖木迭兒复相，以复仇为事，答里麻辞去。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi, Temuder became chancellor again and made revenge his business; Dalima resigned.
translations.idiomatic: In 1321 Temuder returned as chancellor and pursued vendettas; Dalima resigned his post.

sentences.zh: 明年，改燕南道廉访副使。

translations.literal: The next year, he was transferred to Vice Commissioner of the Yannan Circuit Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed vice commissioner of the Yannan surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 开州达鲁花赤石不花歹颇著政绩，同僚忌之，嗾民诬其与民妻俞氏饮。

translations.literal: The Kai Prefecture Darughachi Shibuhuadai had achieved considerable administrative merit; colleagues envied him and incited the people to accuse him of drinking with a commoner's wife, Mistress Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Shibuhuadai, the Darughachi of Kai Prefecture, had distinguished himself in office; jealous colleagues incited locals to accuse him of drinking with a commoner's wife, Mistress Yu.

sentences.zh: 答里麻察知俞氏乃八十老妪，石不花歹实不与饮酒，于是抵诬告者罪，石不花歹复还职。

translations.literal: Dalima investigated and learned that Mistress Yu was an eighty-year-old woman and that Shibuhuadai had in fact not drunk with her; he therefore punished the false accusers, and Shibuhuadai was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima found that Mistress Yu was an eighty-year-old woman and that Shibuhuadai had never drunk with her; he punished the false accusers and restored Shibuhuadai to his post.

sentences.zh: 行唐县民斫桑道侧，偶有人借斧削其杖，其人夜持杖劫民财，事觉，并逮斧主与盗同下狱。

translations.literal: A man in Xingtang County was cutting mulberry trees beside the road; someone happened to borrow his axe to trim a staff; that person used the staff by night to rob a commoner of property; when the matter came to light, both the axe owner and the thief were arrested and imprisoned together.
translations.idiomatic: A man in Xingtang County was cutting mulberry trees by the roadside when someone borrowed his axe to trim a walking staff; that man later used the staff at night to rob a passerby. When the crime was discovered, both the axe owner and the robber were arrested and imprisoned together.

sentences.zh: 答里麻原其未尝知情，即纵之。

translations.literal: Dalima excused him on the ground that he had never known; he was immediately released.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima found that the axe owner had known nothing of the crime and released him at once.

sentences.zh: 深州民媪怒殴兒妇死，妇方抱其子，子亦误触死。

translations.literal: An old woman in Shen Prefecture beat her daughter-in-law to death in anger; the daughter-in-law was holding her child, and the child also died from accidental contact.
translations.idiomatic: In Shen Prefecture an elderly woman beat her daughter-in-law to death in a rage; the daughter-in-law was holding her baby, and the child also died when struck in the struggle.

sentences.zh: 媪年七十，同僚议免刑，答里麻不可，曰：「国制，罪人七十免刑，为其血气已衰，不任刑也。

translations.literal: The old woman was seventy; colleagues proposed exempting her from punishment; Dalima would not agree, saying: "By national law, criminals aged seventy are exempt from punishment because their vital force has declined and they cannot bear punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The woman was seventy, and colleagues argued she should be exempt from punishment. Dalima refused, saying, "Under the law of the realm, criminals aged seventy are spared punishment because their vital force has waned and they can no longer endure it.

sentences.zh: 媪既能杀二人，何谓衰老？」

translations.literal: If this old woman could kill two people, what does 'decline of vital force' mean?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet this woman was strong enough to kill two people—how can she be called decrepit?"

sentences.zh: 卒死狱中。

translations.literal: She ultimately died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: She ultimately died in prison.

sentences.zh: 至治元年，除济宁路总管，兴学劝农，百废具修，府无停事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi he was appointed Prefect of Jining Circuit; he promoted schools and encouraged agriculture; a hundred neglected tasks were all restored; the prefecture had no backlog of business.
translations.idiomatic: In 1321 he was appointed prefect of Jining Circuit, where he promoted schools and agriculture, restored neglected public works, and left the prefectural office with no backlog of cases.

sentences.zh: 济阳县有牧童持铁连结击野雀，误杀同牧者，系狱数岁。

translations.literal: In Jiyang County a shepherd boy held an iron chain to strike wild sparrows and accidentally killed a fellow shepherd; he was imprisoned for several years.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiyang County a shepherd boy was using an iron chain to strike at wild sparrows when he accidentally killed a companion; he remained in prison for several years.

sentences.zh: 答里麻曰：「小兒误杀同牧者，实无杀人意，难以定罪。」

translations.literal: Dalima said: "The boy accidentally killed a fellow shepherd; he truly had no intent to kill; it is difficult to convict him."
translations.idiomatic: Dalima said, "The boy killed his companion by accident and had no intent to kill; he cannot properly be convicted of murder."

sentences.zh: 罚铜遣之。

translations.literal: He fined him in copper and sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: He imposed a fine in copper and released him.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，升福建廉访使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding he was promoted to Commissioner of the Fujian Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1324 he was promoted to commissioner of the Fujian surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 朝廷遣宦官伯颜催督绣段，横取民财，宣政院判官术邻亦取赂于富僧，答里麻皆劾之。

translations.literal: The court sent the eunuch Boyan to urge and supervise embroidered silks, extorting the people's wealth; the Xuanzheng Yuan judge Shulin also took bribes from wealthy monks; Dalima impeached them all.
translations.idiomatic: The court had sent the eunuch Boyan to supervise the production of embroidered silks, and he extorted money from the people; Shulin, a judge of the Xuanzheng Yuan, also took bribes from wealthy monks; Dalima impeached them all.

sentences.zh: 迁浙西廉访使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Zhexi Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commissioner of the Zhexi surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 会文宗发江陵，阿兒哈秃来谕旨，求赂不获，还谮于朝，召至京，处以重罪。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong set out from Jiangling, Arhatu came to convey the imperial command; Dalima would not give a bribe; Arhatu returned and slandered him at court; Dalima was summoned to the capital and sentenced to a heavy penalty.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong set out from Jiangling, Arhatu came bearing the imperial command; when Dalima refused his demand for a bribe, Arhatu returned to court and slandered him; Dalima was summoned to the capital and sentenced to a heavy penalty.

sentences.zh: 比至，帝怒解，迁上都同知留守。

translations.literal: By the time he arrived, the emperor's anger had subsided; he was transferred to Associate Defender of the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he reached the capital, the emperor's anger had cooled; he was appointed associate defender of the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 天历二年八月，明宗崩，文宗入正大统，使者旁午。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Tianli, Emperor Mingzong died; Emperor Wenzong entered and assumed the great succession; messengers came and went incessantly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of 1329 Emperor Mingzong died and Emperor Wenzong assumed the throne; messengers arrived in an unbroken stream.

sentences.zh: 答里麻朝暮尽力，事无缺失，帝特赐锦衣以嘉之。

translations.literal: Dalima exerted himself morning and evening; no matter was neglected; the emperor specially bestowed brocade robes in commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima labored from morning to night without neglecting a single duty; the emperor specially rewarded him with brocade robes in recognition.

sentences.zh: 天历三年，迁淮东廉访使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianli he was transferred to Commissioner of the Huaidong Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1330 he was transferred to commissioner of the Huaidong surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 明年，召拜刑部尚书。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was summoned and appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 国制，新君即位，必赐诸王、驸马、妃主及宿卫官吏金帛。

translations.literal: By national regulation, when a new ruler acceded, gold and silks must be bestowed on princes, imperial sons-in-law, imperial consorts, and palace guard officials.
translations.idiomatic: By established custom, when a new emperor took the throne, gold and silks were distributed to princes, imperial sons-in-law, consorts, and palace guard officials.

sentences.zh: 答里麻曰：「必唱名给散，无虚增之数。」

translations.literal: Dalima said: "Names must be called out when distributing; there must be no fictitious increase in numbers."
translations.idiomatic: Dalima insisted that distributions be made only by calling out each recipient's name, with no inflated numbers on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 国费大省，帝复赐黄金腰带以旌其能。

translations.literal: State expenditure was greatly reduced; the emperor again bestowed a golden belt to commend his ability.
translations.idiomatic: State expenditure was greatly reduced, and the emperor again rewarded him with a golden belt in recognition of his efficiency.

sentences.zh: 元統元年，陞遼陽行省參知政事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuantong he was promoted to Vice Administrator of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In 1333 he was promoted to vice administrator of the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 高丽国使朝京，道过辽阳，谒省官，各奉布四匹、书一幅，用征东省印封之。

translations.literal: An envoy of the Goryeo state came to court; passing through Liaoyang he called on the provincial officials, each presenting four bolts of cloth and one letter, sealed with the seal of the Eastern Campaign Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When a Goryeo envoy came to court and passed through Liaoyang, he called on the provincial officials, each of whom was offered four bolts of cloth and a letter sealed with the Eastern Campaign Secretariat's seal.

sentences.zh: 答里麻诘其使曰：「国制，设印以署公牍、防奸伪，何为封私书？

translations.literal: Dalima questioned the envoy, saying: "By national regulation, seals are established to affix official documents and guard against fraud—why seal a private letter?
translations.idiomatic: Dalima questioned the envoy: "Under the law of the realm, seals exist to authenticate official documents and prevent fraud—why use one to seal a private letter?

sentences.zh: 况汝出国时，我尚在京，未为辽阳省官，今何故有书遗我？

translations.literal: Moreover, when you left your country I was still in the capital and was not yet an official of the Liaoyang Secretariat—why should there now be a letter left for me?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when you left your country I was still in the capital and was not yet an official in Liaoyang—why should you now have a letter for me?

sentences.zh: 汝君臣何欺诈如是耶？」

translations.literal: Why are your ruler and ministers so deceitful as this?"
translations.idiomatic: Why are your sovereign and ministers so deceitful?"

sentences.zh: 使辞屈，还其书与布。

translations.literal: The envoy was speechless; he returned the letter and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy had no reply and returned the letter and cloth.

sentences.zh: 元统三年，迁山东廉访使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuantong he was transferred to Commissioner of the Shandong Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1335 he was transferred to commissioner of the Shandong surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 时山东盗起，陈马骡及新李白昼杀掠。

translations.literal: At that time bandits arose in Shandong; Chen Maluo and Xin Li robbed and killed by daylight.
translations.idiomatic: At that time banditry broke out in Shandong; Chen Maluo and Xin Li led daylight raids and killings.

sentences.zh: 答里麻以为官吏贪污所致，先劾去之而后上擒贼方略。

translations.literal: Dalima believed this was caused by the corruption of officials; he first impeached and removed them, then submitted a plan for capturing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Dalima believed the unrest was caused by corrupt officials; he first impeached and removed them, then submitted a plan for capturing the bandits.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘉纳之，即遣兵擒获，齐鲁以安。

translations.literal: The court approved and adopted it; troops were immediately dispatched and the bandits captured; Qi and Lu were thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his plan, troops were dispatched at once, the bandits were captured, and Qi and Lu were pacified.

sentences.zh: 除大都路留守。

translations.literal: He was appointed Defender of the Dadu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed defender of the Dadu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 帝宴大臣于延春阁，特赐答里麻白鹰以表其贞廉。

translations.literal: The emperor feasted his ministers at the Yanchun Pavilion and specially bestowed on Dalima a white hawk to mark his integrity and purity.
translations.idiomatic: At a feast for his ministers in the Yanchun Pavilion, the emperor specially gave Dalima a white hawk as a token of his integrity.

sentences.zh: 帝尝命答里麻修七星堂，先是，修缮必用赤绿金银装饰，答里麻独务朴素，令画工图山林景物，左右年少皆不然。

translations.literal: The emperor once ordered Dalima to repair the Seven Stars Hall; previously, repairs always used red, green, gold, and silver ornament; Dalima alone pursued simplicity, ordering painters to depict mountain and forest scenery; the young attendants on left and right all disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once ordered Dalima to renovate the Seven Stars Hall. Previous renovations had always used gold, silver, and bright pigments; Dalima insisted on simplicity and had painters depict mountain and forest scenery, to the disapproval of the younger attendants around him.

sentences.zh: 是岁秋，车驾自上京还，入观之，乃大喜，以手抚壁叹曰：「有心哉，留守也！」

translations.literal: That autumn, when the imperial carriage returned from the Upper Capital, the emperor entered to view it and was greatly pleased; he stroked the wall with his hand and sighed: "How thoughtful, this Defender!"
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, when the emperor returned from the Upper Capital and entered to view the hall, he was delighted; stroking the wall he exclaimed, "What thoughtful care the Defender has taken!"

sentences.zh: 賜白金五十兩、錦衣一襲。

translations.literal: He bestowed fifty taels of white gold and one suit of brocade robes.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded him with fifty taels of white gold and a suit of brocade robes.

sentences.zh: 至正六年，陞河南行省右丞，改翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhizheng he was promoted to Right Chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat, then changed to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1346 he was promoted to right chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat, then transferred to Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 至正七年，遷陝西行臺中丞，時年六十九。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhizheng he was transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; he was then sixty-nine years old.
translations.idiomatic: In 1347 he was transferred to vice censor-in-chief of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 致事後，召商議中書平章政事，不拜，全俸優養終身。

translations.literal: After he retired from office, he was summoned to deliberate as Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat; he did not accept; he received his full salary in generous support for life.
translations.idiomatic: After his retirement he was summoned to serve as a deliberating Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat but declined; he received his full salary in generous support for the rest of his life.

sentences.zh: 月魯帖木兒，卜領勤多禮伯臺氏。

translations.literal: Yuelutiemuer was of the Bolingqinduoliboqitai clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelutiemuer was of the Bolingqinduoliboqitai clan.

sentences.zh: 曾祖贵裕，事太祖，为管领怯怜口怯薛官。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Guiyu served the Taizu Emperor and was officer in charge of the qielian kou qieshi.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Guiyu had served Emperor Taizu as officer in charge of the qielian households of the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 祖合剌，袭父职，事世祖。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hela inherited his father's post and served the Shizu Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hela inherited his father's post and served Emperor Shizu.

sentences.zh: 父普兰奚，由宿卫为中书右司员外郎，与丞相哈剌哈孙建议迎立武宗，累迁至山北辽东道肃政廉访使。

translations.literal: His father Pulanxi, from palace guard service became Outer Section Member of the Right Secretariat of the Central Secretariat; with Chancellor Halaqhasun he proposed welcoming and establishing Emperor Wuzong; he was repeatedly promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of the Shanbei Liaodong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His father Pulanxi rose from the imperial guard to outer section member of the right secretariat of the Central Secretariat; with Chancellor Halaqhasun he had urged the enthronement of Emperor Wuzong, and was eventually promoted to surveillance commissioner of the Shanbei Liaodong circuit.

sentences.zh: 月鲁帖木兒幼警颖，读书强记，俶傥有大志。

translations.literal: Yuelutiemuer from youth was alert and clever; in reading he had a strong memory; he was unconventional and had great ambition.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood Yuelutiemuer was quick-witted and had an excellent memory; he was bold and ambitious.

sentences.zh: 年十二，成宗命与哈剌哈孙之子脱欢同入国学。

translations.literal: At age twelve, Emperor Chengzong ordered him to enter the National Academy together with Halaqhasun's son Tuohuan.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve he was ordered by Emperor Chengzong to enter the National Academy together with Halaqhasun's son Tuohuan.

sentences.zh: 仁宗时入宿卫，一日，帝顾问左右曰：「斯人容貌不凡，谁之子耶？」

translations.literal: During Emperor Renzong's reign he entered palace guard service; one day the emperor asked those beside him: "This man's appearance is extraordinary—whose son is he?"
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Renzong's reign he joined the imperial guard; one day the emperor asked his attendants, "This man has an unusual bearing—whose son is he?"

sentences.zh: 左右忘其父名，月鲁帖木兒即对曰：「臣父普兰奚也。」

translations.literal: Those beside him forgot his father's name; Yuelutiemuer immediately replied: "Your servant's father is Pulanxi."
translations.idiomatic: His attendants could not recall the father's name; Yuelutiemuer answered at once, "Your servant's father is Pulanxi."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「汝父赞谋以定国难，朕未尝忘。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Your father aided with counsel to settle the national crisis; I have never forgotten."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Your father counseled me through the national crisis; I have never forgotten him."

sentences.zh: 因命脱忽台传旨四怯薛扎撒火孙，令常侍禁廷，毋止其入。

translations.literal: He therefore ordered Tuohutai to convey the command to the four keshik and the imperial guard: he was to attend constantly at the forbidden court and none was to bar his entry.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered Tuohutai to convey to the four keshik and the imperial guard that Yuelutiemuer was to attend constantly at court and none was to bar his entry.

sentences.zh: 哈剌哈孙欲用为中书蒙古必阇赤，辄辞焉。

translations.literal: Halaqhasun wished to employ him as Mongol Secretary of the Central Secretariat; he repeatedly declined.
translations.idiomatic: Halaqhasun wished to appoint him Mongol secretary of the Central Secretariat, but he repeatedly declined.

sentences.zh: 哈剌哈孙曰：「汝年幼，欲何为乎？」

translations.literal: Halaqhasun said: "You are young—what do you wish to do?"
translations.idiomatic: Halaqhasun asked, "You are still young—what do you want to do?"

sentences.zh: 对曰：「欲为御史尔。」

translations.literal: He replied: "I wish to be a censor, that is all."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "I wish to serve as a censor."

sentences.zh: 人壮其志。

translations.literal: People admired his ambition.
translations.idiomatic: People admired his ambition.

sentences.zh: 久之，遂拜监察御史，巡按上都，劾奏太师、右丞相帖木迭兒受张弼赇六万贯，贷死。

translations.literal: After a long time he was appointed Supervising Censor; inspecting the Upper Capital he impeached the Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Temuder for accepting sixty thousand strings of cash in bribes from Zhang Bi and commuting a death sentence.
translations.idiomatic: Eventually he was appointed supervising censor; while inspecting the Upper Capital he impeached Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Temuder for accepting a bribe of sixty thousand strings of cash from Zhang Bi and commuting a death sentence.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，碎太师印，赐月鲁帖木兒钞万贯，除兵部郎中，拜殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged, shattered the Grand Preceptor's seal, bestowed on Yuelutiemuer ten thousand strings of paper money, appointed him Director of the Ministry of War, and invested him as Palace Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged, destroyed the Grand Preceptor's seal, rewarded Yuelutiemuer with ten thousand strings of paper money, appointed him director of the Ministry of War, and made him palace attending censor.

sentences.zh: 迁给事中、左侍仪、同修起居注。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Supervising Secretary, Left Attendant of Ceremonies, and Associate Compiler of the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to supervising secretary, left attendant of ceremonies, and associate compiler of the imperial diary.

sentences.zh: 寻为右司郎中，赐坐便殿，帝顾左右谓曰：「月鲁帖木兒识量明远，可大用者也。」

translations.literal: Shortly he became Director of the Right Secretariat; granted a seat in the side hall, the emperor turned to those beside him and said: "Yuelutiemuer's discernment and capacity are clear and far-reaching; he can be greatly employed."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became director of the right secretariat; seated in the side hall, the emperor told his attendants, "Yuelutiemuer has clear vision and great capacity; he is fit for high office."

sentences.zh: 他日，帝语近臣曰：「朕闻前代皆有太上皇之号，今皇太子且长，可居大位，朕欲为太上皇，与若等游观西山以终天年。」

translations.literal: Another day the emperor said to his close ministers: "I have heard that previous dynasties all had the title Retired Emperor; now the Crown Prince has grown and can occupy the great position; I wish to become Retired Emperor and roam and view the Western Hills with you to end my days."
translations.idiomatic: On another occasion the emperor told his close ministers, "I have heard that previous dynasties all had retired emperors; now the crown prince has come of age and can take the throne. I wish to become a retired emperor and spend my remaining years roaming the Western Hills with you."

sentences.zh: 御史中丞蛮子、翰林学士明里董阿皆称善。

translations.literal: The Censor-in-Chief Manzi and Hanlin Academician Minglidong'a all praised it as good.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Manzi and Hanlin academician Minglidong'a both praised the idea.

sentences.zh: 月鲁帖木兒独起拜曰：「臣闻昔之所谓太上皇，若唐玄宗、宋徽宗，皆当祸乱，不得已而为之者也。

translations.literal: Yuelutiemuer alone rose and bowed, saying: "Your servant has heard that the so-called Retired Emperors of old, such as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Emperor Huizong of Song, all faced calamity and disorder and did so only because they had no choice.
translations.idiomatic: Yuelutiemuer alone rose and bowed, saying, "Your servant has heard that the so-called retired emperors of old, such as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang and Emperor Huizong of Song, all took that title only amid calamity and disorder, when they had no other choice.

sentences.zh: 愿陛下正大位，以保万世无疆之业，前代虚名，何足慕哉！」

translations.literal: I pray Your Majesty will hold the great position properly, to preserve the enterprise without boundary for ten thousand generations; the empty titles of previous ages—what is there to admire?"
translations.idiomatic: I pray that Your Majesty will hold the throne firmly and preserve the realm's boundless inheritance; what is there to admire in the empty titles of former ages?"

sentences.zh: 帝善其对。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his reply.

sentences.zh: 仁宗崩，帖木迭兒复入中书，据相位。

translations.literal: When Emperor Renzong died, Temuder re-entered the Central Secretariat and held the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Renzong's death, Temuder returned to the Central Secretariat and seized the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 参议乞失监以受人金带系狱，帖木迭兒乃使乞失监诉月鲁帖木兒为御史时诬丞相受赇。

translations.literal: Consultant Qishijian was imprisoned for accepting a golden belt from someone; Temuder then had Qishijian accuse Yuelutiemuer of, when he was a censor, falsely charging the chancellor with taking bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Consultant Qishijian was imprisoned for accepting a golden belt as a bribe; Temuder then had Qishijian accuse Yuelutiemuer of having falsely charged the chancellor with bribery when he was a censor.

sentences.zh: 皇太后命丞相哈散等即徽政院推问不实，事遂释。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ordered Chancellor Hasan and others to conduct inquiry immediately at the Huizheng Yuan; the charge was found untrue and the matter was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered Chancellor Hasan and others to investigate at once in the Huizheng Yuan; the charge proved false and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 帖木迭兒乃奏以月鲁帖木兒为山东盐运司副使，降亚中大夫为承事郎，期月间盐课增以万计。

translations.literal: Temuder then memorialized appointing Yuelutiemuer Vice Commissioner of the Shandong Salt Transport Office, demoting him from Vice Director of the Palace to Gentleman for Managing Affairs; within a month salt revenue increased by tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Temuder then had Yuelutiemuer appointed vice commissioner of the Shandong Salt Transport Office, demoting him from vice director of the palace to gentleman for managing affairs; within a month salt revenue increased by tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 丁外艰，扶丧西还。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his father and escorted the coffin westward to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Upon his father's death he escorted the coffin westward to return home.

sentences.zh: 擢山南江北道肃政廉访副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Surveillance Commissioner of the Shannan Jiangbei Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice surveillance commissioner of the Shannan Jiangbei circuit.

sentences.zh: 泰定初，迁汴梁路总管，再调总管武昌，以养亲不赴。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taiding he was transferred to Prefect of Bianliang Circuit; he was again transferred to Prefect of Wuchang but did not take up the post in order to care for his parents.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Taiding reign he was appointed prefect of Bianliang Circuit and then transferred to prefect of Wuchang, but declined in order to care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 致和元年，河南行省平章伯颜矫制起月鲁帖木兒为本省参知政事，共议起兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, Henan Branch Secretariat Pingzhang Bayan, by forged imperial command, summoned Yuelutiemuer as Vice Administrator of that province to deliberate together on raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: In 1328 Bayan, Pingzhang of the Henan Branch Secretariat, forged an imperial order summoning Yuelutiemuer as vice administrator of the province to join in planning a military rising.

sentences.zh: 月鲁帖木兒固辞曰：「皇子北还，问参政受命何人，则将何辞以对？」

translations.literal: Yuelutiemuer firmly declined, saying: "When the prince returns from the north and asks the Vice Administrator from whom he received his commission, what words will he have to answer with?"
translations.idiomatic: Yuelutiemuer firmly declined, saying, "When the prince returns from the north and asks the vice administrator who gave him his commission, what answer will he give?"

sentences.zh: 伯颜怒。

translations.literal: Bayan was enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was enraged.

sentences.zh: 会明里董阿迓皇子过河南，而月鲁帖木兒为御史时尝劾其娶娼女冒受封，明里董阿因说伯颜收之，丞相别不花亦与之有隙，乃谪月鲁帖木兒乾宁安抚司安置。

translations.literal: It happened that Minglidong'a was escorting the prince through Henan; when Yuelutiemuer had been a censor he had once impeached Minglidong'a for marrying a prostitute and fraudulently receiving a title; Minglidong'a therefore persuaded Bayan to take action against him; Chancellor Biebuhua also had a grudge against him; Yuelutiemuer was therefore demoted and placed under the Ganning Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Minglidong'a happened to be escorting the prince through Henan; when Yuelutiemuer had been a censor he had impeached Minglidong'a for marrying a prostitute and fraudulently receiving a title. Minglidong'a persuaded Bayan to act against him, and Chancellor Biebuhua, who also bore a grudge, joined in; Yuelutiemuer was demoted and placed under the Ganning Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 至顺四年，移置雷州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhishun he was transferred and placed at Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In 1333 he was transferred to Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元六年，顺帝召之还。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhiyuan, Emperor Shundi summoned him back.
translations.idiomatic: In 1340 Emperor Shundi summoned him back.

sentences.zh: 至正二年，入觐，帝欲留之，以母丧未葬辞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhizheng he came to audience; the emperor wished to retain him; he declined because his mother's funeral had not yet been buried.
translations.idiomatic: In 1342 he came to court; the emperor wished to retain him, but he declined because his mother's funeral had not yet been conducted.

sentences.zh: 四年，乃起同知将作院事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was finally summoned as Associate Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In 1344 he was finally appointed associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.

sentences.zh: 寻除大宗正府也可札鲁花赤。

translations.literal: Shortly he was appointed Darughachi of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was appointed Darughachi of the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 九年，由太医院使拜翰林学士承旨、知经筵事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, from Commissioner of the Imperial Medical Service he was appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and Director of the Classics Mat lectures.
translations.idiomatic: In 1349, after serving as commissioner of the Imperial Medical Service, he was appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and director of the Classics Mat lectures.

sentences.zh: 进读之际，引援经史，一本于王道，帝嘉纳焉。

translations.literal: When lecturing before the throne, he cited the classics and histories, grounding all in the kingly way; the emperor approved and adopted his teaching.
translations.idiomatic: In his lectures before the throne he drew on the classics and histories, grounding all in the principles of benevolent rule; the emperor warmly approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，江南诸郡盗贼充斥，诏拜月鲁帖木兒平章政事，行省江浙，因言于丞相脱脱曰：「守御江南，为计已缓，若得从权行事，犹有可为。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, bandits filled the various prefectures of Jiangnan; an edict appointed Yuelutiemuer Pingzhang and dispatched him to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat; he therefore said to Chancellor Toghto: "Defending Jiangnan—the plan is already late; if one may act with discretionary authority, there is still something that can be done."
translations.idiomatic: In 1352 bandits overran the prefectures of Jiangnan; an edict appointed Yuelutiemuer Pingzhang and sent him to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat. He told Chancellor Toghto, "Merely defending Jiangnan is already too late a strategy; if I may act with discretionary authority, there is still something that can be done."

sentences.zh: 不从。

translations.literal: Toghto did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Toghto refused.

sentences.zh: 陛辞，赐尚醖、御衣、弓矢、甲胄、卫卒十人、钞万五千贯以行。

translations.literal: Bidding farewell at court, he was bestowed imperial wine, imperial robes, bow and arrows, armor, ten guard soldiers, and fifteen thousand strings of paper money for his journey.
translations.idiomatic: On taking leave of the court he was granted imperial wine, imperial robes, bow and arrows, armor, ten guard soldiers, and fifteen thousand strings of paper money for his journey.

sentences.zh: 比至镇，引僚属集父老询守备之方，招募民兵数千人，号令明肃。

translations.literal: When he reached his post, he gathered subordinates and elders to inquire about methods of defense, recruited several thousand militia, and his commands were clear and strict.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching his post he gathered his staff and local elders to discuss defense, recruited several thousand militiamen, and enforced clear and strict discipline.

sentences.zh: 统师次建德，获首贼何福斩于市，遂复淳安等县，俘获万餘人，复业者三万餘家。

translations.literal: Leading his army he halted at Jiande, captured the chief bandit He Fu and executed him in the market, then recovered Chun'an and other counties; over ten thousand were captured and more than thirty thousand households returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Leading his troops he encamped at Jiande, captured the bandit leader He Fu and executed him in the market, then recovered Chun'an and other counties; more than ten thousand captives were taken and over thirty thousand households returned to their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 是年七月，次徽州，以疾卒于军中。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of that year he halted at Huizhou and died of illness in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of that year he reached Huizhou and died of illness in camp.

sentences.zh: 卜颜铁木兒

translations.literal: Buyantiemuer
translations.idiomatic: Buyantiemuer

sentences.zh: 卜颜铁木兒，字珍卿，唐兀吾密氏。

translations.literal: Buyantiemuer, style name Zhenqing, was of the Tangwu Wumi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Buyantiemuer, whose style name was Zhenqing, was of the Tangwu Wumi clan.

sentences.zh: 性明锐倜傥，早备宿卫，历事武宗、仁宗、英宗。

translations.literal: His nature was bright, sharp, and unconventional; early he served in the palace guard and attended Emperors Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong.
translations.idiomatic: He was bright, sharp, and unconventional; he entered the imperial guard early and served Emperors Wuzong, Renzong, and Yingzong.

sentences.zh: 天历初，由太常署丞拜监察御史，升殿中侍御史，累除大都路达鲁花赤、都转运盐使、肃政廉访使，由行中书省参知政事升左右丞，擢行御史臺中丞，遂拜江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianli, from Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he was appointed Supervising Censor, promoted to Palace Attending Censor, and repeatedly appointed Dadu Circuit Darughachi, Salt Transport Commissioner, Surveillance Commissioner, from Vice Administrator of the Branch Secretariat promoted to Left and Right Chancellor, elevated to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Branch Censorate, and finally appointed Pingzhang of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianli reign he rose from assistant director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to supervising censor, then palace attending censor; he successively served as Darughachi of Dadu Circuit, salt transport commissioner, and surveillance commissioner, rose from vice administrator to left and right chancellor of the branch secretariat, became vice censor-in-chief of the branch censorate, and was finally appointed Pingzhang of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 至正十二年春，蕲、黄贼徐寿辉遣兵陷湖广，侵江东、西，诏卜颜铁木兒率军讨之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year of Zhizheng, the Qi and Huang bandit Xu Shouhui sent troops who seized Huguang and invaded Jiangdong and Jiangxi; an edict ordered Buyantiemuer to lead an army against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1352 the bandit Xu Shouhui of Qi and Huang sent troops who overran Huguang and invaded Jiangdong and Jiangxi; an edict ordered Buyantiemuer to lead an army against them.

sentences.zh: 卜颜铁木兒益募壮健为兵，得骁勇士三千人、战舰三百艘。

translations.literal: Buyantiemuer further recruited sturdy men as soldiers, obtaining three thousand fierce warriors and three hundred warships.
translations.idiomatic: Buyantiemuer recruited more able-bodied men as soldiers, raising three thousand fierce warriors and three hundred warships.

sentences.zh: 时湖广平章政事也先帖木兒、江西平章政事星吉、江南行台御史中丞蛮子海牙皆以兵驻太平，宿留不进。

translations.literal: At that time Huguang Pingzhang Yexiantiemuer, Jiangxi Pingzhang Xingji, and Jiangnan Branch Censorate Vice Censor-in-Chief Manzi Haiya all had troops stationed at Taiping and lingered without advancing.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yexiantiemuer, Pingzhang of Huguang, Xingji, Pingzhang of Jiangxi, and Manzi Haiya, vice censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate, all had troops at Taiping but lingered without advancing.

sentences.zh: 卜颜帖木兒至，乃与俱前。

translations.literal: When Buyantemuer arrived, they advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: When Buyantiemuer arrived, they advanced together.

sentences.zh: 贼方聚丁家洲，官军猝与遇，奋击败之，遂复铜陵县，擒其贼帅，复池州。

translations.literal: The bandits were gathered at Dingjiazhou; the government army suddenly encountered them, fought fiercely and defeated them, then recovered Tongling County, captured their bandit chief, and recovered Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were gathered at Dingjiazhou; the government forces suddenly encountered them, fought fiercely and routed them, recovered Tongling County, captured their leader, and retook Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 遂分遣万户普贤奴屯阳陵，王建中屯白面渡，闾兒讨无为州，而自率镇抚不花、万户明安驻池口，以防遏上流，为之节度。

translations.literal: He then dispatched Ten-thousand Household Puxiannu to garrison Yangling, Wang Jianzhong to garrison Baimiandu, Lv'er to attack Wuwei Prefecture, while he himself led Pacification Commissioner Buhua and Ten-thousand Household Ming'an to station at Chikou to block the upper reaches and direct operations.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent the ten-thousand household Puxiannu to garrison Yangling, Wang Jianzhong to garrison Baimiandu, and Lv'er to attack Wuwei Prefecture, while he himself led Pacification Commissioner Buhua and the ten-thousand household Ming'an to hold Chikou and block the upper river, directing overall operations.

sentences.zh: 已而江州再陷，星吉死之。

translations.literal: Before long Jiang Prefecture fell again and Xingji died there.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Jiang Prefecture fell again and Xingji was killed.

sentences.zh: 蛮子海牙及威顺王宽彻普化军俱溃而东。

translations.literal: Manzi Haiya and the army of Prince Weishun Kuanchapuhua both collapsed and fled east.
translations.idiomatic: Manzi Haiya and the army of Prince Weishun Kuanchapuhua both broke and fled eastward.

sentences.zh: 安庆被围益急，遣使来求援。

translations.literal: Anqing was besieged ever more urgently and sent envoys to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing was under increasingly desperate siege and sent envoys to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 诸将皆欲自守信地，卜颜铁木兒曰：「何言之不忠耶！

translations.literal: The generals all wished to hold their own secure territories; Buyantiemuer said: "How disloyal your words are!
translations.idiomatic: The generals all wished to hold their own secure territories; Buyantiemuer said, "How disloyal your words are!

sentences.zh: 安庆与池止隔一水，今安庆固守，是其节也，而救患之义，我其可缓。

translations.literal: Anqing and Chizhou are separated by only one stretch of water; now Anqing holds firm—that is its integrity—and as for the duty of relieving distress, how can we delay?
translations.idiomatic: Anqing and Chizhou are separated by only a stretch of water. Anqing is holding firm—that is its duty—and as for the obligation to relieve a neighbor in distress, how can we delay?

sentences.zh: 且上流官军虽溃，然皆百战之餘，所乏者钱谷器具而已，吾受命总兵，其可视之而不恤哉！」

translations.literal: Moreover, though the government armies of the upper reaches have collapsed, they are all veterans of a hundred battles; what they lack is only money, grain, and equipment; I have received command to command the army—how can I look on and not care!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, though the upstream government forces have been routed, they are all battle-hardened veterans who lack only money, grain, and equipment. I have been ordered to command the army—how can I look on without helping?"

sentences.zh: 即大发帑藏以周之，溃军皆大集，而两军之势复振，安庆之围遂解。

translations.literal: He immediately opened the treasury in great quantity to supply them; the routed armies all gathered in force; the strength of both armies was restored; and the siege of Anqing was thereby lifted.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately opened the treasury to supply them generously; the routed armies regathered in force, both armies recovered their strength, and the siege of Anqing was lifted.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，贼众复来攻池州，众且十万，诸县皆应之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year, the bandit host again came to attack Chizhou; their numbers approached one hundred thousand and all the counties responded.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1353 the bandits again attacked Chizhou with nearly one hundred thousand men, and all the surrounding counties rose in support.

sentences.zh: 卜颜帖木兒会诸将谋曰：「贼表里连结，若俟其筑垒成而坐食诸县之粟，破之实难。

translations.literal: Buyantemuer convened the generals and said: "The bandits are linked inside and out; if we wait until they finish building fortifications and live off the grain of the various counties, defeating them will truly be difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Buyantiemuer convened his generals and said, "The bandits are linked inside and out; if we wait until they finish their fortifications and live off the grain of the surrounding counties, defeating them will be very hard.

sentences.zh: 今新至疲弊，如乘其骄惰，尽锐攻之，则顷刻之间功可成矣。」

translations.literal: They have newly arrived and are weary; if we seize their arrogance and indolence and attack with all our elite forces, success can be achieved in an instant."
translations.idiomatic: They have just arrived and are exhausted; if we strike while they are arrogant and slack, and attack with our full strength, victory can be won in an instant."

sentences.zh: 众曰：「诺。」

translations.literal: All said: "Agreed."
translations.idiomatic: All agreed.

sentences.zh: 遂分番与战，果大败之，擒其伪帅，俘斩无算，诸县复平，遂乘胜率舟师以进。

translations.literal: They then fought in shifts and indeed inflicted a great defeat, captured their false commander, took and killed countless prisoners, pacified all the counties, and then pressed forward by boat in victory.
translations.idiomatic: They fought in relays and inflicted a crushing defeat, captured their rebel commander, took and killed countless prisoners, pacified all the counties, and then advanced by fleet in victory.

sentences.zh: 五月，与战于望江，又战小孤山及彭泽，又战龙开河，皆破走之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month they fought at Wangjiang, again at Xiaogushan and Pengze, and again at Longkai River; in each case they routed and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they fought at Wangjiang, then at Xiaogushan and Pengze, and again at Longkai River, routing the enemy each time.

sentences.zh: 进复江州，留兵守之。

translations.literal: Advancing they recovered Jiang Prefecture and left troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced and recovered Jiang Prefecture, leaving troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 七月，进兵攻蕲州，擒其伪帅邹普泰，遂克其城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month they advanced to attack Qi Prefecture, captured the false commander Zou Putai, and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they advanced on Qi Prefecture, captured the rebel commander Zou Putai, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 进兵道士洑，焚其栅，抵兰溪口。

translations.literal: Advancing to Daoshifu they burned their palisades and reached Lanxikou.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Daoshifu they burned the enemy palisades and reached Lanxikou.

sentences.zh: 贼之巢曰黄连寨，又克而歼之。

translations.literal: The bandits' nest was called Huanglian Stockade; they again captured and annihilated it.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits' stronghold was called Huanglian Stockade; they captured and destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 分兵平两巴河，于是江路始通。

translations.literal: Dividing forces they pacified Liangba River; the river route was thereby opened.
translations.idiomatic: They sent detachments to pacify Liangba River, and the river route was finally reopened.

sentences.zh: 十一月，与蛮子海牙、四川行省参知政事哈临秃、左丞桑秃失里、西宁王牙罕沙军合，而湖广左丞伯颜不花等军皆会。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he joined with Manzi Haiya, Sichuan Branch Secretariat Vice Administrator Halintu, Left Chancellor Sangtushili, and the army of Prince Xining Yahansha; the armies of Huguang Left Chancellor Bayan Buhua and others all assembled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he joined forces with Manzi Haiya, Halintu, vice administrator of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat, Left Chancellor Sangtushili, and the army of Prince Xining Yahansha, while the armies of Bayan Buhua, left chancellor of Huguang, and others also assembled.

sentences.zh: 十二月，分道进攻蕲水县，拔其伪都，获伪将相而下四百餘人，徐寿辉仅以身免。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they attacked Qishui County by separate routes, seized their false capital, captured more than four hundred false ministers and generals and below; Xu Shouhui alone escaped with his body.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they attacked Qishui County by separate routes, seized the rebel capital, and captured more than four hundred rebel officials and generals; Xu Shouhui alone escaped.

sentences.zh: 以功诏赐上尊、黄金带。

translations.literal: For his merit an edict bestowed superior wine and a golden belt.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements an edict granted him superior wine and a golden belt.

sentences.zh: 时丞相脱脱方总戎南征，闻诸贼皆已破，乃檄伯颜不花征淮东，蛮子海牙守裕溪口，威顺王还武昌，而卜颜铁木兒独控长江。

translations.literal: At that time Chancellor Toghto was commanding the southern campaign; hearing that all the bandits had been broken, he issued orders for Bayan Buhua to campaign in Huaidong, Manzi Haiya to guard Yuxikou, Prince Weishun to return to Wuchang, while Buyantiemuer alone controlled the Yangzi River.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chancellor Toghto was commanding the southern campaign; hearing that the bandits had been defeated, he ordered Bayan Buhua to campaign in Huaidong, Manzi Haiya to guard Yuxikou, and Prince Weishun to return to Wuchang, while Buyantiemuer alone held the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月，复以军守池州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixteenth year he again garrisoned Chizhou with his army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of 1356 he again garrisoned Chizhou with his army.

sentences.zh: 十一月，卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he died.

sentences.zh: 卜颜铁木兒持身廉介，人不敢干以私，其为将，所过不受礼遗宴犒，民不知有兵。

translations.literal: Buyantiemuer maintained himself with integrity and purity; no one dared approach him with private requests; as a general, wherever he passed he accepted no gifts, banquets, or rewards; the people did not know there was an army.
translations.idiomatic: Buyantiemuer was scrupulously honest; no one dared approach him with private requests. As a general, wherever he passed he accepted no gifts, banquets, or rewards, and the people scarcely knew an army was present.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，幼养于叔父阿术，事之如亲父。

translations.literal: His nature was supremely filial; from youth he was raised by his uncle Ashu and served him as a true father.
translations.idiomatic: He was deeply filial; raised from childhood by his uncle Ashu, he served him as he would his own father.

sentences.zh: 常乘花马，时称为花马兒平章云。

translations.literal: He often rode a piebald horse; at the time he was called Pingzhang Huama'er.
translations.idiomatic: He often rode a piebald horse and was known at the time as Pingzhang Huama'er, the Piebald Horse.

sentences.zh: 星吉，字吉甫，河西人。

translations.literal: Xingji, style name Jifu, was a man of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji, whose style name was Jifu, was from Hexi.

sentences.zh: 曾祖朵吉，祖搠思吉朵而只，父搠思吉，世事太祖、宪宗、世祖为怯里马赤。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Duoji, grandfather Suosijiduorezhi, and father Suosiji all served Emperors Taizu, Xianzong, and Shizu as qielimachi.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Duoji, grandfather Suosijiduorezhi, and father Suosiji had all served Emperors Taizu, Xianzong, and Shizu as qielimachi.

sentences.zh: 星吉少给事仁宗潜邸，以精敏称。

translations.literal: Xingji from youth served in Emperor Renzong's hidden residence and was known for keen intelligence.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Xingji served in Emperor Renzong's household before his accession and was known for keen intelligence.

sentences.zh: 至治初，授中尚监，改右侍仪，兼修起居注。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhizhi he was appointed Director of the Central Palace Service, transferred to Right Attendant of Ceremonies, and concurrently Compiler of the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhizhi reign he was appointed director of the Central Palace Service, then transferred to right attendant of ceremonies and associate compiler of the imperial diary.

sentences.zh: 拜监察御史，有直声。

translations.literal: He was appointed Supervising Censor and had a reputation for uprightness.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed supervising censor and earned a reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 自是十五迁为宣政院使，出为江南行御史臺御史大夫。

translations.literal: From this he was promoted fifteen times to Commissioner of the Xuanzheng Yuan, then sent out as Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted fifteen times in succession to commissioner of the Xuanzheng Yuan, then appointed censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 时承平日久，内外方以观望为政，星吉独持风裁，御史行部，必敕厉而遣之。

translations.literal: At that time peace had lasted long; inside and outside all took a wait-and-see attitude in government; Xingji alone upheld discipline; when censors toured the circuits he always admonished them sternly before dispatching them.
translations.idiomatic: Peace had lasted so long that officials everywhere adopted a wait-and-see attitude; Xingji alone upheld strict discipline, and whenever he sent censors on circuit tours he admonished them sternly before their departure.

sentences.zh: 湖东佥事三宝住，儒者也，性廉介，所至搏贪猾无所贷。

translations.literal: Hudong Associate Commissioner Sanbaozhu was a Confucian scholar, upright and incorruptible by nature; wherever he went he struck at the greedy and cunning without mercy.
translations.idiomatic: Sanbaozhu, associate commissioner of Hudong, was a Confucian scholar of incorruptible character who struck at the greedy and cunning wherever he went without mercy.

sentences.zh: 御史有以自私请者，拒不纳，则诬以事劾之。

translations.literal: A censor made a private request to him; he refused to accept it; the censor then falsely charged him with an offense and impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: When a censor made a private request of him, he refused; the censor then fabricated charges and impeached him.

sentences.zh: 章至，星吉怒曰：「若人之廉，孰不知之，乃敢为是言耶！」

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, Xingji said in anger: "That man's integrity—who does not know it? Yet you dare speak such words!"
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, Xingji said angrily, "Everyone knows that man's integrity—how dare you make such an accusation!"

sentences.zh: 即奏杖御史而白其誣。

translations.literal: He immediately memorialized to cane the censor and clear the false charge.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately memorialized to have the censor caned and to clear the false charge.

sentences.zh: 执政者恶之，移湖广行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Those in power disliked him and transferred him to Pingzhang of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The ruling faction disliked him and transferred him to Pingzhang of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 湖广地连江北，威顺王岁尝出猎，民病之。

translations.literal: Huguang bordered the north of the Yangzi; Prince Weishun went out hunting every year and the people suffered from it.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang bordered the north bank of the Yangzi; Prince Weishun went hunting every year and the people suffered greatly.

sentences.zh: 又起广乐园，多萃名倡巨贾以网大利，有司莫敢忤。

translations.literal: He also built the Guangle Garden, gathering famous entertainers and great merchants to net great profit; no official dared oppose him.
translations.idiomatic: He also built the Guangle Garden, gathering famous entertainers and wealthy merchants to reap great profits, and no official dared oppose him.

sentences.zh: 星吉至，谒王，王阖中门，启左扉，召以入。

translations.literal: When Xingji arrived he called on the prince; the prince closed the central gate and opened the left side door, summoning him to enter.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingji arrived to call on the prince, the prince closed the central gate and opened only the left side door to admit him.

sentences.zh: 星吉引绳床坐王中门西，言曰：「吾受天子命来作牧，非王私臣也，焉得由不正之道入乎！」

translations.literal: Xingji drew a rope bed and sat west of the prince's central gate, saying: "I have received the Son of Heaven's command to come as governor; I am not the prince's private servant—how can I enter by an improper way!"
translations.idiomatic: Xingji drew up a rope bed and sat west of the central gate, saying, "I have received the Son of Heaven's command to govern this region; I am not your private servant—how can I enter by an improper entrance!"

sentences.zh: 阍者惧，入告王，王命启中门。

translations.literal: The gatekeeper was afraid and went in to tell the prince; the prince ordered the central gate opened.
translations.idiomatic: The gatekeeper was alarmed and reported to the prince, who ordered the central gate opened.

sentences.zh: 星吉入，责王曰：「王帝室之懿，古之所谓伯父叔父者也。

translations.literal: Xingji entered and reproached the prince: "Your Highness is an honored member of the imperial house, what the ancients called paternal uncle or maternal uncle.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji entered and reproached the prince: "Your Highness is a kinsman of the imperial house, what the ancients called a royal uncle.

sentences.zh: 今德音不闻，而骋猎宣淫，贾怨于下，恐非所以自贻多福也。」

translations.literal: Now no virtuous reputation is heard, yet you roam hunting and indulge in dissipation, buying resentment below— I fear this is not the way to secure abundant blessings for yourself."
translations.idiomatic: Yet no word of your virtue is heard, while you roam hunting and indulge in dissipation, earning resentment among the people—I fear this is not the way to secure blessings for yourself."

sentences.zh: 王急握星吉手谢之，为悉罢其所为。

translations.literal: The prince hastily grasped Xingji's hand and apologized, abolishing all that he had done.
translations.idiomatic: The prince hastily grasped Xingji's hand and apologized, abolishing all his excesses.

sentences.zh: 有胡僧曰小住持者，服三品命，恃宠横甚，数以事凌轹官府。

translations.literal: There was a Hu monk called Little Abbot who held third-rank appointment, relied on favor and was extremely overbearing, repeatedly bullying the government offices on various pretexts.
translations.idiomatic: There was a Hu monk called Little Abbot who held third-rank appointment, relied on imperial favor, and repeatedly bullied government offices.

sentences.zh: 星吉命掩捕之，得妻妾女乐妇女十有八人，狱具，罪而籍之，由是豪强敛手，贫弱称快。

translations.literal: Xingji ordered a secret arrest; eighteen wives, concubines, female musicians, and women were found; the case was complete; he was convicted and his property registered; from this the powerful held back their hands and the poor rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji ordered his secret arrest; eighteen wives, concubines, female musicians, and women were found; he was convicted and his property confiscated; from then on the powerful held back and the poor rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 至正十一年，汝、颍妖贼起，会僚属议之，或曰：「有郑万户，老将也，宜起而用之。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhizheng, demonic bandits arose in Ru and Ying; convening his subordinates to discuss it, some said: "There is Ten-thousand Household Zheng, an old general—it is fitting to summon and employ him."
translations.idiomatic: In 1351 rebel bandits arose in Ru and Ying; when Xingji convened his staff to discuss the crisis, some said, "There is the ten-thousand household Zheng, an old general—we should summon and employ him."

sentences.zh: 星吉乃命募士兵，完城池，修器械，严巡警，悉以其事属郑。

translations.literal: Xingji then ordered recruitment of militia, repair of city walls, preparation of weapons, strict patrols, and entrusted all these matters to Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji then ordered the recruitment of militia, repair of the city walls, preparation of weapons, and strict patrols, entrusting all these matters to Zheng.

sentences.zh: 贼闻之，遣其党二千来约降。

translations.literal: The bandits heard of this and sent two thousand of their followers to negotiate surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits heard of this, they sent two thousand men to negotiate surrender.

sentences.zh: 星吉与郑谋曰：「此诈也，然降而却之，于是为不宜，宜受而审之可也。」

translations.literal: Xingji and Zheng deliberated: "This is a deception; yet to accept surrender and then reject it would be improper—it is fitting to accept and investigate."
translations.idiomatic: Xingji and Zheng agreed: "This is a ruse, but to accept their surrender and then reject them would be improper; we should accept them and investigate."

sentences.zh: 果得其情，乃歼之，械其渠魁数十人以俟命。

translations.literal: They indeed obtained the truth, then annihilated them and shackled several dozen of their ringleaders to await orders.
translations.idiomatic: They confirmed the deception, annihilated the force, and shackled several dozen ringleaders to await orders.

sentences.zh: 适有旨召为大司农。

translations.literal: Just then an edict summoned him as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Just then an edict summoned him to the capital as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 同僚受贼赂，且嫉其功，乃诬郑罪，释其所械者。

translations.literal: Colleagues had accepted bribes from the bandits and, jealous of his achievements, falsely charged Zheng with crimes and released those he had shackled.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues who had taken bribes from the bandits and envied Xingji's achievements falsely charged Zheng with crimes and released the prisoners he had shackled.

sentences.zh: 明日，贼大至，内外响应，城遂陷。

translations.literal: The next day the bandits came in force; inside and outside responded; the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the bandits arrived in force; the city rose in response inside and out, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 武昌之人骈首夜泣曰：「大夫不去，吾岂为俘囚乎？」

translations.literal: The people of Wuchang, heads together, wept by night: "Had the Grandee not left, how could we have become captives?"
translations.idiomatic: The people of Wuchang wept together by night: "Had our commissioner not left, how could we have become captives?"

sentences.zh: 星吉既入见，具陈贼本末。

translations.literal: When Xingji had entered for audience, he fully reported the beginning and end of the bandit affair.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingji appeared at court he gave a full account of the bandit uprising.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，命赐食。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and ordered food bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and ordered a meal served.

sentences.zh: 时宰不悦，奏为江西行省平章政事，员外置。

translations.literal: The chief ministers were displeased and memorialized appointing him Pingzhang of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, established outside the regular quota.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers were displeased and had him appointed Pingzhang of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat on an extra-staff basis.

sentences.zh: 星吉至江东，诏令守江州。

translations.literal: When Xingji reached Jiangdong, an edict ordered him to defend Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Xingji reached Jiangdong, an edict ordered him to defend Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 时江州已陷，贼据池阳。

translations.literal: At that time Jiang Prefecture had already fallen and the bandits held Chiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Prefecture had already fallen and the bandits held Chiyang.

sentences.zh: 太平官军止有三百人，贼号百万，众皆欲走。

translations.literal: The government troops at Taiping numbered only three hundred; the bandits claimed a million; all wished to flee.
translations.idiomatic: The government troops at Taiping numbered only three hundred; the bandits claimed a million men; everyone wished to flee.

sentences.zh: 星吉曰：「畏贼而逃，非勇也；

translations.literal: Xingji said: "To flee from fear of bandits is not courage;
translations.idiomatic: Xingji said, "To flee from fear of bandits is not courage;

sentences.zh: 坐而待攻，非智也。

translations.literal: to sit and await attack is not wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: to sit and await attack is not wisdom.

sentences.zh: 汝等皆有妻子财物，纵逃其可免乎？」

translations.literal: You all have wives, children, and property—even if you flee, can you escape?"
translations.idiomatic: You all have wives, children, and property—even if you flee, can you escape?

sentences.zh: 乃贷富人钱，募人为兵。

translations.literal: He then borrowed money from the wealthy and recruited men as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He borrowed money from the wealthy and recruited soldiers.

sentences.zh: 先是，行台募兵，人给百五十千，无应者。

translations.literal: Previously the Branch Censorate had recruited soldiers, offering one hundred fifty thousand cash per man, with no respondents.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the branch censorate had offered one hundred fifty thousand cash per recruit, with no takers.

sentences.zh: 至是，星吉募兵，人五十千，从争赴之，一日得三千人。

translations.literal: Now Xingji recruited soldiers at fifty thousand per man; followers competed to join; in one day he obtained three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Now Xingji offered fifty thousand per recruit and men competed to join; in one day he raised three thousand.

sentences.zh: 乃具舟楫直趋铜陵，克之。

translations.literal: He then equipped boats and went straight to Tongling and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He equipped boats and sailed straight to Tongling, which he captured.

sentences.zh: 又破贼白马湾。

translations.literal: He again defeated the bandits at Baimawan.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated the bandits at Baimawan.

sentences.zh: 贼败走，分兵蹑之，抵白湄。

translations.literal: The bandits were defeated and fled; he divided forces to pursue them and reached Baimai.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were routed and fled; he sent detachments in pursuit and reached Baimai.

sentences.zh: 贼穷急，回拒官军，官军乘胜奋击，贼尽殪，擒其渠魁周驴，夺船六百艘，军声大振，遂复池州。

translations.literal: The bandits in desperate straits turned to resist the government army; the government army seized victory and fought fiercely; the bandits were all killed; their ringleader Zhou Lv was captured; six hundred boats were seized; military prestige greatly rose; and Chizhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered, the bandits turned to fight; the government forces pressed their advantage and killed them to the last man, capturing their leader Zhou Lv and seizing six hundred boats. Military prestige soared, and Chizhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 乃命诸将分道讨贼，复石埭诸县。

translations.literal: He then ordered the generals to pursue the bandits by separate routes and recovered Shizhi and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered his generals to pursue the bandits by separate routes and recovered Shizhi and other counties.

sentences.zh: 贼复来攻，命王惟恭列阵当之，锋始交，出小舰从旁横击，大破走之，进据清水湾。

translations.literal: The bandits again came to attack; he ordered Wang Weigong to form battle lines to meet them; as the vanguards had just engaged, he sent small boats to strike from the flank and inflicted a great defeat driving them off, advancing to occupy Qingshuiwan.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits attacked again, he ordered Wang Weigong to form battle lines; as the vanguards engaged, he sent small boats to strike from the flank, routing the enemy and advancing to occupy Qingshuiwan.

sentences.zh: 伺者告贼舰至自上流，顺风举帆，众且数十倍，诸将失色。

translations.literal: Scouts reported bandit ships arriving from upstream with favorable wind and sails raised; their numbers were nearly ten times greater; the generals turned pale.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported bandit ships approaching from upstream under full sail with favorable wind, nearly ten times their strength; the generals turned pale.

sentences.zh: 星吉曰：「无伤也，风势盛，彼仓卒必不得泊，但伏横港中偃旗以待，俟过而击之，无不胜矣。」

translations.literal: Xingji said: "No harm; the wind is strong—they in haste surely cannot moor; only lie in ambush in the cross-channel with flags lowered and wait; strike after they pass—there is none you cannot defeat."
translations.idiomatic: Xingji said, "No matter—the wind is strong and they will not be able to moor in haste. Lie in ambush in the cross-channel with flags lowered and strike after they pass; you cannot fail."

sentences.zh: 风怒水驶，贼奄忽而过，乃命举旗张帆鼓噪而薄之，官军殊死战，风反为我用，又大破之。

translations.literal: The wind raged and the water rushed; the bandits suddenly passed; he then ordered flags raised, sails spread, and drums and shouts as they closed in; the government army fought to the death; the wind turned to their use; and they again inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The wind roared and the current raced; the bandits swept past; he ordered flags raised, sails spread, and drums beaten as his forces closed in. The government troops fought to the death; the wind shifted in their favor, and they inflicted another crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 时贼久围安庆，捷闻，遽烧营走。

translations.literal: At that time the bandits had long besieged Anqing; when news of victory arrived, they hastily burned their camps and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits had long besieged Anqing; when news of the victory arrived, they hastily burned their camps and fled.

sentences.zh: 进复湖口县，克江州，留兵守之。

translations.literal: Advancing he recovered Hukou County, captured Jiang Prefecture, and left troops to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced and recovered Hukou County, captured Jiang Prefecture, and left troops to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 命王惟恭栅小孤山，而星吉自据番阳口，缀江湖要冲以图恢复。

translations.literal: He ordered Wang Weigong to fortify Xiaogushan while Xingji himself held Panyangkou, linking the vital points of rivers and lakes to plan recovery.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Wang Weigong to fortify Xiaogushan while he himself held Panyangkou, controlling the vital river junctions to plan the recovery of the region.

sentences.zh: 时湖广已陷，江西被围，淮、浙亦多故，卒无继援之者，日久粮益乏，士卒咸困。

translations.literal: At that time Huguang had fallen, Jiangxi was besieged, Huai and Zhe also had many troubles; in the end there was no one to bring relief; as days lengthened grain grew ever scarcer and the soldiers were all distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang had fallen, Jiangxi was besieged, and Huai and Zhe were also in turmoil; no relief came, and as time passed grain grew scarce and the soldiers were exhausted.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「东南完实，盍因粮以图再举乎？」

translations.literal: Someone said: "The southeast is intact and substantial—why not use its grain to plan another rising?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "The southeast is still intact—why not withdraw there with its grain and plan another campaign?"

sentences.zh: 星吉曰：「吾受命守江西，必死于此。」

translations.literal: Xingji said: "I have received command to defend Jiangxi—I must die here."
translations.idiomatic: Xingji said, "I have been ordered to defend Jiangxi—I will die here."

sentences.zh: 众莫敢复言。

translations.literal: None dared speak again.
translations.idiomatic: No one dared speak again.

sentences.zh: 有顷，贼乘大船四集，来攻我军，取蒹苇编为大筏，塞上下流火之。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits gathered in four great ships and came to attack the government army; they took reeds and rushes and wove them into great rafts, blocked the upper and lower reaches, and set them afire.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits gathered four large ships and attacked the government forces; they wove reeds into great rafts, blocked the upper and lower reaches of the river, and set them ablaze.

sentences.zh: 我军力战，众死且尽。

translations.literal: The government army fought fiercely; the host died to the last man.
translations.idiomatic: The government troops fought fiercely until nearly all were dead.

sentences.zh: 星吉之从子伯不华与亲兵数十人死之。

translations.literal: Xingji's nephew Bohua and several dozen personal guards died with them.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji's nephew Bohua and several dozen personal guards died fighting.

sentences.zh: 星吉犹坚坐不动。

translations.literal: Xingji still sat firmly without moving.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji remained seated, unmoving.

sentences.zh: 賊發矢射星吉，乃昏仆。

translations.literal: The bandits shot arrows at Xingji; he then fainted and fell.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits shot arrows at Xingji, and he collapsed unconscious.

sentences.zh: 贼素闻星吉名，不忍害，舁置密室中，至旦乃苏。

translations.literal: The bandits had long heard Xingji's name and could not bear to harm him; they carried him to a secret chamber, and by dawn he revived.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits had long heard of Xingji's reputation and could not bring themselves to kill him; they carried him to a secret chamber, and by dawn he had revived.

sentences.zh: 贼罗拜，争馈以食。

translations.literal: The bandits bowed in a circle and competed to offer him food.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits bowed before him and competed to offer him food.

sentences.zh: 星吉斥之，遂不复食。

translations.literal: Xingji rebuked them and thereafter ate no more.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji rebuked them and refused to eat again.

sentences.zh: 凡七日，乃自力而起，北面再拜曰：「臣力竭矣。」

translations.literal: After seven days he rose by his own strength, bowed twice to the north, and said: "Your servant's strength is exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: After seven days he rose by his own strength, bowed twice to the north, and said, "Your servant's strength is exhausted."

sentences.zh: 遂绝，年五十七。

translations.literal: He then expired; he was fifty-seven years old.
translations.idiomatic: He then died at the age of fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 星吉为人公廉明决，及在军中，能与将士同甘苦，以忠义感激人心，故能以少击众、得人死力云。

translations.literal: Xingji as a man was fair, incorruptible, clear, and decisive; when in the army he could share hardship and comfort with officers and soldiers, moving people's hearts with loyalty and righteousness; therefore he could strike the many with the few and win men's utmost effort unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Xingji was fair, incorruptible, and decisive; in the army he shared hardship and comfort with his officers and soldiers, inspiring loyalty and righteousness in their hearts. Thus he could defeat larger forces with smaller ones and win men's utmost devotion unto death.

sentences.zh: 福寿，唐兀人。

translations.literal: Fushou was a man of Tangwu.
translations.idiomatic: Fushou was from Tangwu.

sentences.zh: 幼俊茂，知读书，尤善应对。

translations.literal: From youth he was handsome and flourishing; he knew how to read and was especially skilled in repartee.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he was handsome and accomplished; he was literate and especially skilled in conversation.

sentences.zh: 既长，入备环卫，用年劳授长宁寺少卿，改引进使，升知侍仪使，进正使。

translations.literal: When grown he entered palace guard service; for years of service he was appointed Vice Director of the Changning Temple, transferred to Introducing Commissioner, promoted to Director of the Ceremonies Office, and advanced to Chief Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When he came of age he joined the imperial guard; for long service he was appointed vice director of the Changning Temple, then transferred to introducing commissioner, promoted to director of the ceremonies office, and finally made chief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 出为饶州路达鲁花赤，擢淮西廉访副使。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Darughachi of Raozhou Circuit and promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Huaixi Surveillance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Darughachi of Raozhou Circuit and promoted to vice commissioner of the Huaixi surveillance commission.

sentences.zh: 入为工部侍郎，佥太常礼仪院事，拜监察御史，改户部侍郎，升尚书，出为燕南廉访使，又五迁为同知枢密院事。

translations.literal: He entered as Vice Minister of Works, Associate of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Rites, appointed Supervising Censor, transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue, promoted to Minister, sent out as Commissioner of the Yannan Surveillance Commission, and five times promoted to Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as vice minister of works, associate of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Rites, and supervising censor; he was transferred to vice minister of revenue, promoted to minister, sent out as commissioner of the Yannan surveillance commission, and promoted five times to vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 至正十一年，颍州以贼反告，时车驾在上都，朝堂皆犹豫未决，欲驿奏以待命。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhizheng, Ying Prefecture reported bandit rebellion; at that time the imperial carriage was at the Upper Capital; the court all hesitated without decision and wished to report by post station and await orders.
translations.idiomatic: In 1351 Ying Prefecture reported a bandit rebellion; the emperor was at the Upper Capital, and the court hesitated, wishing to report by courier and await orders.

sentences.zh: 福寿独以谓「比使得请还，则事有弗及矣」。

translations.literal: Fushou alone said: "By the time the envoy obtains permission and returns, matters will be beyond remedy."
translations.idiomatic: Fushou alone said, "By the time a messenger obtains permission and returns, it will be too late."

sentences.zh: 于是决议调兵五百，遣卫官哈剌章、忻都、怯来讨之而后以闻。

translations.literal: They therefore resolved to dispatch five hundred troops, sending guard officers Halazhang, Xindu, and Qie to suppress them and then report.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore resolved to dispatch five hundred troops under guard officers Halazhang, Xindu, and Qie to suppress the rebels and report afterward.

sentences.zh: 顺帝善其处事得宜，明年，改也可札鲁忽赤。

translations.literal: Emperor Shundi approved his handling as appropriate; the next year he was transferred to Yeke Jarquchi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shundi approved his handling of the crisis; the following year he was appointed Yeke Jarquchi.

sentences.zh: 未几，出为淮南行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as Pingzhang of the Huainan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Pingzhang of the Huainan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是时濠、泗俱已陷，师久无功。

translations.literal: At that time Hao and Si had both fallen; the army had long been without success.
translations.idiomatic: By then Hao and Si had both fallen, and the army had long failed to achieve success.

sentences.zh: 福寿至，督战甚急，而上游贼势甚汹涌，福寿乃议筑石头，断江面，守御有方，众恃以为固。

translations.literal: When Fushou arrived he urged battle very urgently; the bandit force upstream was very fierce; Fushou then proposed building Shitou, cutting off the river surface, and defending with method; the host relied on this as secure.
translations.idiomatic: When Fushou arrived he pressed the fighting urgently; the upstream bandit forces were fierce, so he proposed fortifying Shitou to block the river and organized the defense systematically; the troops relied on this as their stronghold.

sentences.zh: 十五年，迁江南行台御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In 1355 he was transferred to censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 先是，集庆尝有警，阿鲁灰以湖广平章政事将苗军来援，事平，其军镇扬州。

translations.literal: Previously Jiqing had had an alarm; Aruhui as Huguang Pingzhang led Miao troops to aid; when the matter was settled his army garrisoned Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Jiqing had been threatened; Aruhui, Pingzhang of Huguang, had led Miao troops to its relief, and after the crisis his army was garrisoned at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 而阿鲁灰御军无纪律，苗蛮素犷悍，日事杀虏，莫能治。
