translations.literal: But Aruhui commanded his army without discipline; the Miao barbarians were by nature fierce and brutal, daily killing and plundering; none could control them.
translations.idiomatic: But Aruhui commanded his troops without discipline; the Miao soldiers were by nature fierce and brutal, killing and plundering daily, and no one could control them.

sentences.zh: 俄而苗军杀阿鲁灰以叛，而集庆之援遂绝。

translations.literal: Before long the Miao army killed Aruhui in rebellion, and aid to Jiqing was thereby cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Miao troops killed Aruhui in rebellion, and aid to Jiqing was cut off.

sentences.zh: 及高邮、庐、和等州相继沦陷，而集庆势益孤，人心益震恐，且仓库无积蓄，计未知所出，于是民乃愿为兵以自守。

translations.literal: When Gaoyou, Lu, He, and other prefectures fell in succession, Jiqing's position grew ever more isolated, popular hearts grew ever more alarmed and fearful, and moreover the storehouses had no reserves; no plan was known for what to do; the people then wished to become soldiers to defend themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaoyou, Lu, He, and other prefectures fell in succession, Jiqing grew ever more isolated, panic spread among the people, and the storehouses were empty; with no plan in sight, the people volunteered to serve as soldiers in their own defense.

sentences.zh: 福寿因下令民多赀者皆助以粮饷，激厉士众，为完守计。

translations.literal: Fushou therefore ordered that wealthy citizens all contribute grain and provisions, roused officers and soldiers, and made plans for complete defense.
translations.idiomatic: Fushou ordered wealthy citizens to contribute grain and provisions, roused the troops, and organized a comprehensive defense.

sentences.zh: 朝廷知其劳，数赏赉焉。

translations.literal: The court knew his labors and repeatedly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The court recognized his efforts and repeatedly rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 十六年三月，大明兵围集庆，福寿数督兵出战，尽闭诸城门，独开东门以通出入，而城中势不复能支，城遂破。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixteenth year, Ming troops besieged Jiqing; Fushou repeatedly urged troops into battle; all city gates were closed except the east gate left open for passage; but the situation in the city could no longer be sustained and the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of 1356 Ming forces besieged Jiqing; Fushou repeatedly led troops into battle, closed all the city gates except the east gate for passage, but the city could no longer hold and fell.

sentences.zh: 百司皆奔溃，福寿乃独据胡床坐凤凰台下，指麾左右。

translations.literal: All offices fled in collapse; Fushou alone took a folding chair and sat beneath the Phoenix Terrace, directing those beside him.
translations.idiomatic: All government offices collapsed in flight; Fushou alone took a folding chair and sat beneath the Phoenix Terrace, directing his attendants.

sentences.zh: 或劝之去，叱之曰：「吾为国家重臣，城存则生，城破则死，尚安往哉！」

translations.literal: Someone urged him to leave; he rebuked them, saying: "I am a great minister of the state—if the city stands I live, if the city falls I die—where else should I go!"
translations.idiomatic: When someone urged him to flee, he rebuked them: "I am a great minister of the state—if the city stands I live, if it falls I die—where else should I go?"

sentences.zh: 达鲁花赤达尼达思见其独坐若有所为者，从问所决，留弗去。

translations.literal: The Darughachi Danisi, seeing him sit alone as if resolved on something, followed and asked his decision, and stayed without leaving.
translations.idiomatic: The Darughachi Danisi, seeing him sit alone as if resolved on something, asked his intention and stayed without leaving.

sentences.zh: 俄而乱兵四集，福寿遂遇害，不知所在，达尼达思亦死之。

translations.literal: Before long disorderly troops gathered from all sides; Fushou was thereby killed, his whereabouts unknown; Danisi also died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long disorderly troops gathered from all sides; Fushou was killed, his body never found; Danisi also died with him.

sentences.zh: 又同时死者，有治书侍御史贺方。

translations.literal: Also dying at the same time was Investigating Censor He Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Also killed at the same time was investigating censor He Fang.

sentences.zh: 达尼达思字思明。

translations.literal: Danisi's style name was Siming.
translations.idiomatic: Danisi's style name was Siming.

sentences.zh: 贺方字伯京，晋宁人，以文学名。

translations.literal: He Fang's style name was Bojing; he was a man of Jinning, famed for literary accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: He Fang, whose style name was Bojing, was from Jinning and was famed for his literary accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 事闻，朝廷赠福寿金紫光禄大夫、江浙行省左丞相、上柱国，追封卫国公，谥忠肃。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the court posthumously granted Fushou Golden Purple-Gleam Grand Master of the Palace, Left Chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, and Supreme Pillar of State, with posthumous enfeoffment as Duke of Wei and posthumous title Zhongsu.
translations.idiomatic: When news reached the court, Fushou was posthumously granted the titles of Golden Purple-Gleam Grand Master of the Palace, left chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, and supreme pillar of state, enfeoffed as Duke of Wei with the posthumous title Zhongsu, Loyal and Solemn.

sentences.zh: 道童，高昌人，自号石岩。

translations.literal: Daotong was a man of Gaochang and styled himself Shiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Daotong was from Gaochang and styled himself Shiyan, Stone Cliff.

sentences.zh: 性深沉寡言。

translations.literal: His nature was deep and reserved, sparing of words.
translations.idiomatic: He was deep and reserved, sparing of words.

sentences.zh: 以世胄入官，授直省舍人，历官清显，素负能名。

translations.literal: By noble lineage he entered office, appointed Direct Secretariat Attendant; he passed through pure and eminent posts and had long borne a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: By noble birth he entered office as direct secretariat attendant; he held a series of eminent posts and had long enjoyed a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 调信州路总管，移平江，皆以善政称。

translations.literal: Transferred as Prefect of Xinzhou Circuit and moved to Pingjiang, in both he was praised for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: As prefect of Xinzhou Circuit and then of Pingjiang, he was praised for good governance in both posts.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，迁大都路达鲁花赤，出为江浙行省参知政事，寻召参政中书，顷之，又出为江浙行省右丞，遂升本省平章政事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng he was transferred to Dadu Circuit Darughachi, sent out as Vice Administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, shortly summoned as Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat, before long sent out again as Right Chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, and finally promoted to Pingzhang of that province.
translations.idiomatic: In 1341 he was transferred to Darughachi of Dadu Circuit, sent out as vice administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, shortly summoned as vice administrator of the Central Secretariat, then sent out again as right chancellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, and finally promoted to Pingzhang of that province.

sentences.zh: 十一年，诏仍以平章政事行省江西。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict still appointed him Pingzhang to administer Jiangxi province.
translations.idiomatic: In 1351 an edict appointed him Pingzhang to administer Jiangxi province.

sentences.zh: 是年，贼起蕲、黄，平章政事秃坚理不花将兵捍江州。

translations.literal: That year bandits arose in Qi and Huang; Pingzhang Tujianlibuhua led troops to defend Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year bandits arose in Qi and Huang; Pingzhang Tujianlibuhua led troops to defend Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 既而土寇蜂起，道童素不知兵事，仓皇无所措。

translations.literal: Before long local bandits swarmed forth; Daotong had never known military affairs and in panic knew nothing to do.
translations.idiomatic: Before long local bandits swarmed forth; Daotong had no knowledge of military affairs and was at a loss in the crisis.

sentences.zh: 左右司郎中普颜不花曰：「今贼势冲突，城中无备，万一失守，奈何？

translations.literal: Left and Right Secretariat Director Puyanbuhua said: "Now the bandit force is pressing; the city is unprepared—if by chance it is lost, what then?
translations.idiomatic: Left and right secretariat director Puyanbuhua said, "The bandits are pressing hard and the city is unprepared—if it should fall, what then?

sentences.zh: 有章伯颜左丞者，致仕居抚州，其人熟知军务，宜以便宜礼请之，使署本省左丞事，专任调遣军旅，庶幾事有可济。」

translations.literal: There is Left Chancellor Zhang Boyan, retired and living in Fuzhou; that man is well versed in military affairs—it is fitting to invite him with convenient ceremony, have him act in the affairs of left chancellor of this province, and specially charge him with dispatching the army—then perhaps matters can succeed."
translations.idiomatic: There is the retired left chancellor Zhang Boyan living in Fuzhou; he is well versed in military affairs. We should invite him with appropriate ceremony, have him act as left chancellor of this province, and charge him with commanding the army—then perhaps we can succeed."

sentences.zh: 道童从其言，而伯颜亦欣然为起，曰：「此正我报国之秋也。」

translations.literal: Daotong followed his advice; Boyan also gladly rose, saying: "This is precisely the season for me to repay the state."
translations.idiomatic: Daotong followed his advice; Boyan also gladly came forward, saying, "This is precisely the season for me to serve the state."

sentences.zh: 至则与普颜不花设御敌计甚悉。

translations.literal: When he arrived he and Puyanbuhua devised plans against the enemy in great detail.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he and Puyanbuhua devised detailed plans against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，湖广陷，秃坚里不花由江州遁还。

translations.literal: In the first month of the next year Huguang fell; Tujianlibuhua fled back from Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Huguang fell and Tujianlibuhua fled back from Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月，普颜不花将兵往江州，至石头渡，遇贼战败，道童闻之大恐，即怀省印遁走。

translations.literal: In the second month Puyanbuhua led troops toward Jiang Prefecture; at Shitoudu he encountered bandits and was defeated; when Daotong heard this he was greatly afraid and immediately fled with the provincial seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Puyanbuhua led troops toward Jiang Prefecture; at Shitoudu he was defeated by the bandits; when Daotong heard this he was terrified and fled with the provincial seal.

sentences.zh: 普颜不花还，与伯颜定为城守之计。

translations.literal: Puyanbuhua returned and with Boyan settled on plans for city defense.
translations.idiomatic: Puyanbuhua returned and with Boyan organized the city's defense.

sentences.zh: 后数日，道童始自南昌民家来归，遂议分门各守以备敌。

translations.literal: Several days later Daotong returned from a commoner's house in Nanchang; they then deliberated on dividing the gates for separate defense against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Daotong returned from hiding in a Nanchang household; they then organized defense by assigning each gate separately.

sentences.zh: 三月，贼众来围城。

translations.literal: In the third month the bandit host came to besiege the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the bandits came to besiege the city.

sentences.zh: 城中置各厢官及各巷长，昼夕坚守，众心翕然。

translations.literal: In the city they appointed officials for each ward and headmen for each lane; day and night they held firm; popular hearts were united.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were appointed for each ward and headmen for each lane; the people held firm day and night with united resolve.

sentences.zh: 而道童素恤民，能任人，有功者必赏，无功或不加罪，故多为之用。

translations.literal: Daotong had long been compassionate toward the people, able to employ men; those with merit were always rewarded, those without merit were sometimes not punished; therefore many served him.
translations.idiomatic: Daotong had long been compassionate toward the people and skilled at employing men; he always rewarded merit and often overlooked failure, so many served him willingly.

sentences.zh: 贼围城凡两月，而民无离志。

translations.literal: The bandits besieged the city for two months in all, yet the people had no thought of leaving.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits besieged the city for two months, yet the people showed no wish to abandon it.

sentences.zh: 道童密召死士数千人，面涂以青，额抹黄布，衣黄衣，为前锋，又别选精锐数千为中军，而募助阵者殿后。

translations.literal: Daotong secretly summoned several thousand death-defying warriors, their faces painted green, foreheads bound with yellow cloth, dressed in yellow garments as vanguard; he separately selected several thousand elite troops as center army, and recruited supporting fighters as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Daotong secretly summoned several thousand death-defying warriors with green-painted faces, yellow cloth bound on their foreheads, and yellow garments as the vanguard; he selected several thousand elite troops as the center army and recruited supporting fighters as the rear guard.

sentences.zh: 命万户章妥因卜鲁哈歹领之。

translations.literal: He ordered Ten-thousand Household Zhangtuoyinbuluhadai to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the ten-thousand household Zhangtuoyinbuluhadai to lead them.

sentences.zh: 夜半，开门伏兵栅下，黎明，钲鼓大震，因奋击贼，贼惊以为神，败走。

translations.literal: At midnight they opened the gates and lay in ambush beneath the palisade; at dawn gongs and drums thundered; they then struck fiercely at the bandits; the bandits were alarmed and thought it divine, and fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight they opened the gates and lay in ambush beneath the palisade; at dawn gongs and drums thundered and they struck fiercely at the bandits, who fled in alarm, thinking it supernatural.

sentences.zh: 遂乘胜捣其营，复分兵扫其餘党。

translations.literal: They then pressed victory to storm their camp and again divided forces to sweep their remaining followers.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed their victory to storm the enemy camp and sent detachments to sweep up the remaining bandits.

sentences.zh: 是时，章伯颜、普颜不花之功居多。

translations.literal: At that time Zhang Boyan and Puyanbuhua contributed the greater part of the achievement.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhang Boyan and Puyanbuhua contributed the greater part of the victory.

sentences.zh: 伯颜寻以疾卒。

translations.literal: Boyan shortly died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Boyan soon died of illness.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以道童捍城有功，加大司徒、开府，仍赐龙衣御酒。

translations.literal: The court, because Daotong had merit in defending the city, added the titles Grand Steward and Establishment of a Household, and still bestowed dragon robes and imperial wine.
translations.idiomatic: The court rewarded Daotong for defending the city by granting him the titles of grand steward and establishment of a household, along with dragon robes and imperial wine.

sentences.zh: 及秋，朝廷命亦怜真班为江西行省左丞相，火你赤为左丞，同将兵来江西。

translations.literal: By autumn the court appointed Yirenzhenban Left Chancellor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Huonichi Left Chancellor, both leading troops to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: By autumn the court appointed Yirenzhenban left chancellor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and Huonichi left chancellor, both leading troops to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 未几，亦怜真班卒，道童属火你赤平富、瑞二州，分镇其地。

translations.literal: Before long Yirenzhenban died; Daotong assigned Huonichi to pacify Fu and Rui prefectures and garrison their territories separately.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yirenzhenban died; Daotong assigned Huonichi to pacify Fu and Rui prefectures and garrison them separately.

sentences.zh: 适岁大旱，公私匮乏，道童乃移咨江浙行省，借米数十万石、盐数十万引，凡军民约三日人籴官米一斗，入昏钞贰贯，又三日买官盐十斤，入昏钞贰贯，民皆便之。

translations.literal: Just then the year had great drought; public and private stores were depleted; Daotong then sent inquiry to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, borrowing several hundred thousand piculs of rice and several hundred thousand yin of salt; for all soldiers and civilians roughly every three days each person could buy one dou of government rice for two strings of huichao, and every three days buy ten jin of government salt for two strings of huichao; the people all found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought severe drought and scarcity; Daotong requested from the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat several hundred thousand piculs of rice and several hundred thousand yin of salt. Soldiers and civilians could buy one dou of government rice every three days for two strings of paper money, and ten jin of government salt every three days for two strings; the people found this arrangement convenient.

sentences.zh: 由是按堵如故，而贼亦不敢犯其境。

translations.literal: Thereby peace was maintained as before, and the bandits also did not dare invade his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Peace was maintained as before, and the bandits did not dare invade his territory.

sentences.zh: 十八年夏四月，陈友谅复攻江西城。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the eighteenth year, Chen Youliang again attacked the Jiangxi capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of 1358, Chen Youliang again attacked the Jiangxi capital.

sentences.zh: 时火你赤已升平章政事，加营国公，行便宜事，任专兵柄，而素与道童不相能，且贪忍不得将士心，见城且陷，遂夜遁去。

translations.literal: At that time Huonichi had been promoted to Pingzhang, added the title Duke Who Establishes the State, granted discretionary authority, and held sole military power; he had long been incompatible with Daotong and was greedy and cruel, winning no hearts among officers and soldiers; seeing the city about to fall, he fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: By then Huonichi had been promoted to Pingzhang, granted the title Duke Who Establishes the State and discretionary authority, and held sole military power; he had long been at odds with Daotong and was greedy and cruel, winning no loyalty from his troops; seeing the city about to fall, he fled by night.

sentences.zh: 道童亦弃城退保抚州路，欲集诸县义兵以图克复，而势已不可为。

translations.literal: Daotong also abandoned the city and withdrew to defend Fuzhou Circuit, wishing to gather righteous troops from the various counties to plan recovery, but the situation was already beyond remedy.
translations.idiomatic: Daotong also abandoned the city and withdrew to Fuzhou Circuit, hoping to gather militia from the surrounding counties to recover the lost territory, but the situation was already hopeless.

sentences.zh: 因叹曰：「我为元朝大臣，官至极品，今城陷不守，尚何面目复见人乎！」

translations.literal: He therefore sighed and said: "I am a great minister of the Yuan dynasty, my office reached the highest rank—now the city has fallen and I could not hold it—what face have I to meet people again!"
translations.idiomatic: He sighed and said, "I am a great minister of the Yuan dynasty who reached the highest rank—now the city has fallen and I could not hold it—what face have I left to show the world?"

sentences.zh: 适贼追者至，道童欲迎敌，渡水，未登岸，贼众乘之，遂为所害。

translations.literal: Just then bandit pursuers arrived; Daotong wished to meet the enemy; crossing the water, before he reached the bank, the bandit host pressed upon him and he was thereby killed.
translations.idiomatic: Just then bandit pursuers arrived; Daotong tried to face them, but while crossing a river before he reached the bank, the bandits overtook him and killed him.

sentences.zh: 事闻，赐谥忠烈。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was granted the posthumous title Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: When news reached the court, he was granted the posthumous title Zhonglie, Loyal and Valiant.
